Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated the electron’s mass (~9.11e-27 kg) instead of the correct ~9.11e-31 kg, reversing the comparison and concluding the proton is lighter than the electron. This order-of-magnitude error led to the wrong answer (the correct choice is the electron) and was finalized prematurely without verification.
